product.name: TOUGH MASTER Aviation Snip Left Cut for Sheet Metal, Aluminium, PVC Pipe - 250 Milimetres (TM-AS10L)
product.description: Need a pair of aviation snips to tackle those tough cutting jobs? Try the TOUGH MASTER TM-AS10L Aviation Snip, ideal for long left cuts. This helpful tool is made from premium Cr-Mo steel that is processed with high frequency heat treatment and CNC wave serrations for aggressive shearing action, as well as high resistance to tooth breakage and longer blade life. The left cut aviation snip has a special processed axial bolt to extend the tool’s service life and offers one-handed locking thanks to an automatic snap latch. These aviation tin snips are comfortable to use over long periods, too, with a TPR ergonomic handle that prevents slippage. A valve-grade steel return spring provides trouble-free cutting and superior durability, while a blade ruler guarantees high precision. Cut using the drywall construction tool with more handle force to the cutting blades for significantly less fatigue during use. These heavy duty aviation snips can cut 1.2mm carbon steel and 0.7mm stainless steel as well as hard materials such as metal wire, keel, aluminum, sheet metal, thin PVC pipe, and square steel pipe. Reliable and robust construction is provided by reinforced rivets.

product.name: Swell Fountain Pump - 1450LPH for Garden Pond Fish
product.description:
Swell Fountain Pumps are robust and reliable garden pond pumps with flow rates of 720-3,400 lph. This particular model, the 1450, has a max flow rate of 1,450 lph. These pumps also feature a thermal cut-off switch that prevents your pond pump from overheating and cuts off the power supply if you attempt to run the pump dry. With an internal strainer to keep debris out of the pump and protect components, the unit not only boasts great results but is energy efficient too. 

Larger models of this garden pond pump (1450, 2400 and 3500) include a stepped hosetail adapter and an adjustable outlet to power an additional waterfall or pond filter. Swell Fountain Pumps are designed to create a spectacular feature in your garden pond. They come with four fountain heads and are suitable for small to medium-sized ponds. Capable of pumping up to 3,400 lph, these low maintenance pumps have a three-year guarantee for added peace of mind.

Ideal for those with sensitive skin, this repellent is perfect for outdoor activities where reliable, skin-friendly insect protection is essential.

How to use: 

1. Apply the repellent to all exposed skin - dispense a small amount on to the palm of your hand and rub in well. 
2. Apply sparingly on the face, neck and around the ears, avoiding the eyes and mouth. for a child, the repellent must be applied by an adult. Do not apply to the child's hand. Not suitable for any children under 2 years of age.

Key Points:
- To reduce the risk of bites, wear clothing so that minimal skin (such as face, neck, forearms, hands and feet) is exposed 
- For a child, the repellent must be applied by an adult. 
- Do not apply to the child's hand. 
- Not suitable for any children under 2 years of age.

product.name: ENGO E25 Smart Thermostat Starter Pack Zigbee Radiator Control Black
product.description: The ENGO E25 Starter Pack is a complete smart radiator heating solution designed for customers who want full smart heating control straight out of the box. This pack includes the ENGO E25 battery powered smart thermostat, the ENGO smart radiator valve ETRV-M30, and the ENGO gateway required for app based smart features. The thermostat measures room temperature and sends heating setpoints wirelessly using Zigbee RF 868 communication. The smart radiator valve physically opens and closes the radiator to regulate heat output, providing accurate and efficient room by room radiator heating control. One E25 thermostat can control multiple smart radiator valves within the same room. With the included gateway, users can access the ENGO app to create heating schedules, timers, and automation. Remote control and monitoring are available through the app, making this a true smart heating system. Important functionality information:The thermostat itself does not support on device programming. Manual temperature adjustment is available on the thermostat. All schedules and smart automation are created using the ENGO app. This starter pack is designed specifically for ENGO smart heating systems and is not compatible with other brands or generic Zigbee hubs. It is ideal for customers starting a smart radiator heating system from scratch.

This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 8mm to 10mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible fin which will seal any gap from 11mm to 16mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

product.name: Spudulica White 80gsm Non-Woven Geotextile Membrane 2.25m x 10m 22.5m² Garden Drainage Fabric
product.description:
Spudulica 80gsm Non-Woven Geotextile Membrane – Lightweight Garden Drainage & Separation Fabric

Planning a garden drainage or landscaping project? Spudulica's 80gsm non-woven geotextile membrane is a lightweight, water-permeable fabric designed to help keep soil and aggregate layers separate while allowing water to pass through.

Ideal for lighter-duty drainage and landscaping applications, this versatile fabric can be used in French drains, suitable soakaway installations, garden drainage trenches and gravel landscaping projects.

Made from thermally bonded non-woven polypropylene, the fabric creates a practical filtration and separation layer, helping reduce the movement of soil particles into surrounding drainage aggregates.

Each cut piece measures 2.25m wide x 10m long, providing 22.5m² of material. It is easy to cut, position and shape around drainage components and garden features.

Supplied boxed and folded for convenient delivery, making it a practical option for DIY projects without purchasing a full roll.

Please note: This is a lightweight 80gsm geotextile intended for suitable filtration and separation applications. For more demanding ground conditions, higher loading or greater puncture resistance, a heavier-grade geotextile may be required. The membrane should be covered after installation and is not designed for prolonged UV exposure.

product.name: 12mm 30 Metre PVC Clear Plastic Flexible Hose Pipe With FREE Stainless Steel Clips
product.description:
This Unreinforced PVC Hose represents a flexible and economical choice for low-pressure fluid and air transfer. Fabricated from high-grade soft polyvinyl chloride (PVC), it combines lightweight maneuverability with high transparency, making it easy to visually monitor flow in water, air, and mild chemical applications. With a comprehensive size range from 3mm to 25mm internal diameter, this tubing is adaptable to a wide variety of domestic, laboratory, and industrial requirements.

Designed for efficiency, the hose features a smooth bore and consistent wall thickness to ensure reliable flow rates, while its unreinforced nature ensures it remains lightweight and easy to install. It performs consistently in temperatures ranging from -10°C to +65°C, capable of withstanding short-term peaks up to +70°C. The hose offers excellent pliability, supporting bend radii between 20mm and 180mm depending on the bore size. With a working pressure rating of 1.5 Bar and a burst limit of 4.5 Bar, it is robust enough for most general-purpose tasks. Whether used for garden irrigation, PC water cooling loops, or workshop air routing, this clear hose offers a durable, clean, and practical solution.

product.name: 63mm to 76mm (2 1/2" To 3") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: Anthracite Grey Sydney Designer Pre-Filled Electric Towel Rail Bathroom Radiator 500mm x 1200mm
product.description:
The Sydney 500mm x 1200mm Electric Bathroom Radiator in Anthracite combines a unique flat-panel design with a contemporary matte finish, making it a standout addition to any modern bathroom, kitchen, or cloakroom.

Design & Finish
Unique flat/straight steel construction with a matte Anthracite finish. Features a 15-tube layout that provides generous space for warming and airing towels. The extra-slim profile is engineered for restricted wall spaces without compromising on style or practicality.

Dimensions

Width: 500mm

Height: 1200mm

Pipe Centres: 100mm

Tube Dimension: 22mm

Wall to Pipe Centres: 55–95mm

Heat Output

1452 BTU/h

426W

What's Included

Adjustable square metal wall brackets (matching Anthracite)

Blanking plug

Air vent plug

400W electric element

Element Details
IP55 rated with a 1.5m flex cable attached. Operated via a wall switch (no built-in control). Supplied with both chrome and white covers for a clean finish.

Pre-Filled & Ready to Install
Arrives pre-filled with 85% pure water and 5% ethylene glycol anti-freeze, leaving a 10% air gap for safe expansion. The element is shipped separately and must be installed into the left or right bottom side. Once inserted, the radiator is ready to connect to electricity.

Quality & Certification
Tested to BS EN442 standards. 10 bar pressure tested for leaks. Triple layer finish for long-lasting durability. Manufactured in the EU (Not Far East).

Warranty
5 years on the radiator, 2 years on the heating element.

Suitable Rooms
Bathroom, Kitchen, Toilet, Cloakroom, Utility Room.

Kit includes:

1 x 3/4" BSP water butt extension (male and female thread, approx. 50mm)

product.name: 45mm - Blue, Plastic Blanking End Cap Bung for Hose & Pipes
product.description: This Plastic Blanking Plug is a simple yet essential accessory for sealing off the end of hoses quickly and securely. Made from durable ABS plastic, it offers a tough, lightweight, and weather-resistant solution for stopping water flow in garden, pond, or general water pipe systems. Designed with a ribbed barbed profile, the plug grips tightly inside the hose, creating a reliable seal that prevents leaks and ensures water remains contained. Whether you are closing off unused outlets in irrigation systems, sealing pond hoses for maintenance, or temporarily stopping water pipes in DIY projects, this plug provides a cost-effective and efficient fix. Easy to install, simply push the barbed plug into the open end of the hose for a tight and watertight finish, with no need for tools. The durable ABS material resists corrosion, impact, and UV exposure, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use. Compact and lightweight, it helps keep hose systems tidy and controlled while reducing the risk of unwanted leaks or spills. A must-have for gardeners, pond keepers, and DIY enthusiasts, this plug provides practical reliability for a variety of water flow management needs.

product.name: Aluminium Beaded Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (63mm OD, 400mm Long)
product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. Manufactured from high-grade 6063 aluminium, these joiners feature swaged ends with precision-formed beads to prevent hose blow-off and ensure a secure fit under boost or vacuum conditions. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 1m Straight Reinforced Hose Red - 54mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. Available in diameters from 13mm up to 152mm and supplied in 1-metre lengths, each hose provides a smooth internal bore for optimal flow and easy fitment. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: 30mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. product.name: 51mm to 70mm (2" To 2 3/4") Plastic Hose Connector Red Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 180 Degree Silicone Elbow Hose Red - 40mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: This high-performance 180-degree silicone elbow is expertly engineered for demanding applications requiring tight-radius bends and reliable flow. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner layer and reinforced with multiple polyester braids, the SSE180 offers exceptional flexibility and resilience in high-temperature environments from -50°C to +250°C. Compliant with SAEJ20R3 standards, it’s suitable for coolant, air, and water connections in automotive, industrial, and marine systems. The outer layer is made from durable silicone to ensure longevity and resistance to ozone, UV, and chemicals. Each elbow is constructed with 3 or 4 plies of reinforcement, depending on diameter, for optimal pressure performance. Wall thickness remains consistent at 4.5–5.5mm across sizes, supporting working pressures from 2.8 to 12.33 Bar and burst pressures up to 37 Bar. The 100mm leg length and tight bend radius make it perfect for compact installations. Available in a wide range of diameters (6.5mm–102mm), this elbow is ideal for both performance upgrades and OEM replacements where precision and quality are critical.
